utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I haven’t heard any new carpool details yet, but I can ask around and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, can you confirm it with them and tell me once you know?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll check with them and let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll repeat the carpool plan to the others and make sure everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. I might miss a detail or two, so that helps a lot.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll keep it simple and pass the carpool details along to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can do the carpool this week if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, that would help a lot—thank you. I’ll let everyone know you’ve got this week covered.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—thanks. Send me the pickup times when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — what’s the plan for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep track of who’s driving and who needs a ride. How many people are we lining up for tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think it’s just three of us for tomorrow. I can ride with whoever’s available.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can take the morning carpool this week if that helps—what times do you need covered?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be super helpful, thanks! We just need the 8:00 drop-off covered on Monday through Friday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely, I’ve got the 8:00 drop-off Monday through Friday. If anything changes, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—what time should we plan for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, let’s aim for 7:30. That should give us a little buffer.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 7:30 works for me. I’ll be ready a few minutes early.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia, I’m putting together a carpool—want me to save you a spot?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Maybe—what time are you leaving, and where are you picking up? I just need to make sure the timing works.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m aiming to leave around 8:10, and I can swing by your place for pickup. If that works, I’ll save you a spot.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces — what’s the latest on the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the latest roster mostly set, and I’m just confirming a couple of pickup times. Once that’s locked in, I’ll send everyone the final schedule.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — just let me know once the final schedule’s out, and I’ll follow along.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before we set anything, can you remind me of the pickup time and where you want me to meet you?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m not sure we’ve set the pickup time yet—could we pick one now? Meet me out front by my house when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure — what pickup time works best for you? I can meet you out front by your house then.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can take my turn for the carpool, but I may need a little flexibility this week.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That works for me — thanks for taking a turn. Just let me know which day you might need flexibility on.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Probably Thursday, if that’s okay. I’ll confirm as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can help with the carpool. What time are we aiming for?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m thinking 7:30 works best for me. Does that still leave enough time to get everyone there?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, 7:30 should work fine—we’ll still have plenty of time to get everyone there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of that—what time and where should I mark the carpool pickup?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Around 7:45 at my place, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll mark 7:45 at your place.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand if you need anything for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I’ll let you know what we need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, Rey — just give me a holler when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I just want to make sure the timing works for everyone—who’s picking up whom, and at what time?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the pickup order and exact time again? I just want to make sure I’ve got it right.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sure — I’m thinking we should do Mia first, then Sam, and aim for 7:30. If that timing feels off, we can adjust it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara, I can help sort out the carpool—who’s riding with whom this week?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — I’d love that. Let’s pair people up based on who needs a ride each day and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — send me the list of who needs a ride each day, and I’ll pair folks up as simply as I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Dane, do we still have enough room for everyone in the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I think so, but I’m a little late to the details—how many people are we at now?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got six people total right now, unless someone drops out last minute.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, hey Faye — I heard the carpool’s still on for tomorrow, but I’m just checking who’s picking up whom. If you want, I can help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, thanks — I can take the pickup for tomorrow. I’ll grab the kids after school and bring them home.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, thanks Faye — I’ll let everyone know you’ve got the pickup tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what time are we doing carpool?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Let’s do 7:30 tomorrow morning so we have a little buffer.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: 7:30 works for me. I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam. Could you do pickup on Tuesday and Thursday this week?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I can do pickup on Tuesday and Thursday this week.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Nell, I’m putting together the carpool list—want me to save you a spot?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please—put me down for a spot. Thanks for keeping me in the loop!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ve got you on the list, and I’ll keep you posted on the details.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hey Eli, I’m keeping track of the pickup spots—what time and address should I note for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s note 7:30 a.m. at 124 Maple Street. That keeps it simple and on time.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — 7:30 a.m. at 124 Maple Street. I’ll note that for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Hana, are we still on for the carpool tomorrow? What time should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, we’re still on—can you be ready by 7:30? I’ll confirm the exact pickup time tonight.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, 7:30 works for me. Just text me tonight with the exact pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Oren, I’m running errands anyway—what’s the latest on the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—sorry, I keep mixing it up. I haven’t pinned down the latest yet, but I can check and get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No worries—just let me know when you’ve got it sorted.
